errors.evidence: The figure does not specify that the evaluation was performed on an "ECPE dataset". The figure's caption is "ECPE method evaluation", which is about the methods themselves, not necessarily the dataset name.
The x-axis clearly shows the methods are divided into five groups (2阶段笛卡尔积, 矩阵变换, 局部搜索, 序列标注, 外部知识), not six.
The method name is misspelled. The correct name on the chart's x-axis is "E2EECPE".

errors.text_span: ECPE-KT在所有三个指标上均达到最高值
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. While ECPE-KT has the highest P score, its R score (approx. 0.67) is lower than that of TDGC (approx. 0.68).
The F1 score (black bar) for ECPE-KT is approximately 0.71. The P score (blue bar) is 0.75. The description incorrectly attributes the P score's value to the F1 score.
The R score (orange bar) for ECPE-KT is approximately 0.67, which does not exceed 0.70.

errors.text_span: 所有柱状图按方法名称的字母顺序从左到右排列
errors.evidence: The methods are not sorted alphabetically. For example, 'Indep' is followed by 'Inter-CE', not another 'I' or 'J' method. The methods are grouped by their technical category as indicated by the lower x-axis labels.
